initial_state: All 17 exposed registers are explicit. Memory is exactly program bytes, zero-filled scratch stack, and initial.memory patches; every other byte is unknown. Initial baseline equals initial runtime. Initial registers/memory represent accepted pre-Step manual evidence.
delta_semantics: Every omitted register and memory byte is unchanged, including code and scratch stack. Each listed before/after is exact. Decimal memory map keys are byte addresses; null means unknown. Changes must not include equal values. Baseline deltas are independent from runtime deltas.
result_semantics: Step result fields are exact. Empty memory events on failure mean no committed accesses; backend-specific attempted accesses may appear only as extra error diagnostics. Human error messages are not matched. Error code, restored, and listed context values must match; unrelated native diagnostic context may be added.
manual_operations: set_register, set_pc, set_flags, patch_memory apply arguments to runtime and baseline independently; reset copies baseline into runtime. None increments step_seq. Manual actions and reset clear the last Step result.
instruction_origin: program source_line is the one-based synthetic source order, not a pasted parser record. Assembly is an independent verification input; bytes are authoritative for later execution tests.
origins: Origin-label UI behavior is outside these numeric golden cases and requires later core tests; omitted numeric state is never a wildcard.
scope: Phase 1 contracts and independent encoding verification. The consistency checker does not emulate instructions and does not claim product tests have passed.
